results.title: Admission requirements Master's degree | NHL Stenden university of applied sciences
results.snippet:
All non-EU and EU (EEA) applicants are required to submit an English proficiency test with their application to show that their English language skills are at a high enough level to succeed in their studies.

Exceptions can be made for students who have had their preparatory education in a country where English is the only official educational language. [...] If you are applying for an associate degree, bachelor’s degree or master's degree and hold a diploma from a European institution listed here, and English was included as part of the final exam curriculum, then the additional English language test is not required. The same applies to students who have attained General Certificates of Secondary Education (enough O and A/AS levels with the sufficient score), the European Baccalaureate Certificate, International Baccalaureate Diploma, or an IB [...] Diploma, or an IB career-related programme taught fully in English.

# Master’s degrees [...] The master's degrees are generally one-year programmes that help you develop your expertise further. You develop the knowledge you gained during your bachelor’s degree and explore a specific area in detail to become a professional specialist. As a master’s student at a university of applied sciences, you work closely with industry and will usually carry out research for a particular company or organisation, culminating in a thesis that presents your findings and draws conclusions supported by [...] the theoretical knowledge and academic skills needed for a research master’s programme.

results.title: Study at NHL Stenden | NHL Stenden university of applied sciences
results.snippet:
At NHL Stenden, you develop your talents by doing. You explore ideas, work on real challenges and find out what really suits you. You work with students from different backgrounds, learn from each other's perspectives, and step by step, grow into the professional you want to be. And in this international community, right where very different worlds come together, the best ideas grow.

#### Discover internationally recognised bachelor and master programmes, taught fully in English.
